name: 09-squat

The foreground therapist back is plain uninterrupted BLACK fabric throughout the shot: no back logo, lettering, emblem or patch. The tiny chest logo is visible only on the FRONT of her top in the mirror. Keep this front/back distinction stable. Preserve the reference exactly.
